blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `transferOrderToGuestValidationStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that an order can be transferred to a guest customer.
The step throws an error if the order is cancelled, if the resolved customer
is the one already linked to the order, or if the resolved customer is a
registered (non-guest) customer.

children.name: TransferOrderToGuestValidationStepInput
children.description: The details of the guest order transfer to validate.
